technical.summary: Mixed technical setup with strong volume spike and momentum indicators offset by weak trend strength, poor long-term positioning, and overbought stochastic conditions.

fundamental.summary: WFC shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 91 days.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: medium — mixed conviction with one large purchase ($100k-$250k) offset by smaller purchases ($1k-$15k)
sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (20/10) with recent congressional buys including one significant purchase suggests contrarian buy opportunity, though conviction is mixed and lack of recent news sentiment limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with inverted yield curve, crisis VIX (343.2), rising dollar, and recent CPI event creating acute financial sector headwinds despite distant earnings.

debate.key_bull_argument: Volume spike (15x), bullish OBV, supertrend signal, and extreme fear (20/10) with congressional buying create a contrarian entry opportunity at support (37.05) in a capitulation environment.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 343.2, rising DXY), price below 50/200 SMAs, stochRSI overbought, weak money flow (CMF negative), and high earnings risk within 91 days make this a financial sector trap despite technical bounce signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Volume spike (15x) and supertrend bullish signal at support (37.05) with extreme fear sentiment create a contrarian setup; however, macro headwinds and technical weakness below key moving averages limit conviction.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve, VIX crisis (343.2), and rising DXY create severe financial sector headwinds that could overwhelm technical bounce; earnings risk within 91 days adds uncertainty.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents show bullish signals, but fundamental and risk agents strongly oppose entry due to macro deterioration and sector headwinds.
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 32 Financials positions and existing WFC position; sector concentration and earnings proximity (91 days) warrant minimal sizing if entry occurs; portfolio drawdown at 0% allows flexibility but concentration risk is material.
